per_depth.common_affordance: the intrinsic exact-cover/3-dimensional matching structure created by requiring exactly k pockets with distinct coordinates on all three axes
The only incompatibilities are equality of the three individual coordinates; no additional relation between two pockets needs to be tracked.

The exact-k requirement together with complete coverage of each coordinate axis forces the problem to be a 3-dimensional matching: choose one pocket from each x-group with pairwise-distinct y and z values.
Selecting exactly k distinct triples that collectively cover each of the three k-element coordinate domains

per_depth.shortcut_name: three inequalities collapse to pairwise distinct coordinates
